## Website change monitor with screenshots

**What it does:** Polls a web page on a schedule, detects whether its content changed since the last run, and captures a full-page PolyDoc screenshot **only when it changed**, so you never spend a screenshot on an unchanged page. The snapshot is emailed to you.

**Who it's for:** Anyone tracking competitor pages, pricing, docs, or status pages who wants a visual record of every change.

### Setup
1. Set the **url** to watch in the *Settings* node.
2. Add your **PolyDoc API** credential on *Screenshot page* (get a key at dashboard.polydoc.tech).
3. Add an **SMTP** credential on *Email screenshot*, or swap it for Slack / S3 / Google Drive.

A manual test always counts as a first run (changed), so the screenshot branch runs right away. Change state then persists between scheduled runs.

Start free: https://polydoc.tech/?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=template&utm_campaign=screenshot

## 1. Watch on a schedule

Runs every 6 hours. The URL to watch lives in **Settings**, so you edit it in one place.

## 2. Detect a real change

Fetch the page, strip scripts, styles and whitespace, hash it, and compare to the last run (stored in workflow static data). Only a genuine content change continues.

## 3. Capture & send

PolyDoc renders a full-page PNG of the changed page, which is emailed as an attachment.

## Nothing changed

No screenshot is taken. The run ends quietly.
